raw.details:
Adaption Dataset Challenge

Organised by Hackyard, in collaboration with Adaption. Fully online.

What you will do

Build an AI assistant for an underserved language or topic, starting with its data. Create or improve an instruction-tuning dataset with Adaption (Invent a Dataset and/or Adaptive Data) and evaluate it before and after to show how much it improved. Training a model with AutoScientist is optional. Start from a seed dataset you have the right to use and adapt.

You pick the use case. Some ideas:

  • A question-answering assistant for an underserved language.
  • An assistant that explains a specialised topic or service in simple language.
  • An assistant for a clearly defined group of users.

How to join

  • Register once, on Unstop or Hackyard. Do not register on both.
  • Create your Adaption account at https://adaptionlabs.ai/app using the same email you registered with. You can do this right away. If you already have an Adaption account, keep using it.
  • After creating your account, submit a screenshot of it through the Google Form. The form link will be shared with registered participants.
  • Join the WhatsApp group for updates: https://chat.whatsapp.com/DyiXXOZ4ATJ7xVRUpxyKn8?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4
  • Attend the onboarding session with Adaption on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 7:30 PM IST (9:00 AM EST). It covers account setup, dataset preparation, Invent a Dataset, Adaptive Data and AutoScientist. The session is private. The recording will be shared with registered participants only.
  • Start with the Adaption documentation: https://docs.adaptionlabs.ai/

What to submit

Submit once, by December 6, 2026, 11:59 PM IST, on one platform only: here on Unstop, or on your team page in the Hackyard app at https://app.hackyard.org/e/adaption-labs. Share one link that includes:

  • Your dataset created or improved on Adaption.
  • Optional: details of a model you trained with AutoScientist, if you did.
  • Your use case and who it is for.
  • How you used Adaption.
  • Your evaluation results.
  • A README covering your approach, data source and licence, results, limitations and team members.
  • A demo of the assistant.

You keep ownership of what you build. Your submission is shared with Hackyard and Adaption for judging.

Dataset rules

  • Use instruction/response or chat-style data in a format Adaption supports.
  • Use only data you have the right to use. Name the source and licence.
  • No personal, confidential or unsafe content.

Who can join

  • Participants must be at least 18 years old.
  • Open worldwide, subject to applicable laws and Adaption's platform terms.
  • Solo or teams of up to four, as listed on Unstop.

Judging

Hackyard runs judging, and a judge from Adaption's team joins the final round. Projects are scored on:

  • Dataset quality and fit for the use case.
  • Measurable improvement in the dataset before and after.
  • A clear problem, users and practical value.
  • A clear write-up of your decisions, results and limits.

Prizes

  • 1st place: $100 cash for the team, two VIP swag boxes and an extra $1,000 in Adaption credits per member.
  • 2nd and 3rd place: swag boxes and an extra $1,000 in Adaption credits per member.
  • Certificates: certificates of submission for builders who submit a project, and winner certificates for the top 3 teams.

Only projects that use Adaption are eligible for the cash prize. Credits have no cash value and cannot be transferred or sold. All amounts are in US dollars. Winners will be asked for their name, address and phone number to ship swag.

Key dates

  • November 16, 2026: Challenge starts.
  • November 18, 2026: Onboarding session, 7:30 PM IST.
  • December 6, 2026: Registration and submissions close, 11:59 PM IST.
  • December 7 to 13, 2026: Judging.
  • Results: to be announced.

Dates may change. Check the WhatsApp group for updates.

More information

  • Challenge page: https://hackyard.org/events/adaption-labs
  • Questions: hello@hackyard.org

Hackyard shares participant emails with Adaption for account access and credits. Adaption's terms and privacy policy apply when you create an account.
